📖 How to use

  1. Type a keyword like "ocean waves" or "city night" in the search box.
  2. Click Search to fetch matching royalty-free stock videos.
  3. Browse the previews — each shows duration, dimensions and the creator.
  4. Click Download on any video to open and save the MP4 file.

Can I use these videos in commercial projects?

Yes — the download buttons link straight to the video files, which you can save and use in your projects under the Pexels License.

Why do I see a "being set up" message instead of results?

If you see a setup notice instead of results, the search service is still being connected — check back soon.
